title.zh: DSH 插件索引 · 观察池

description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.
description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：会话管家（合并包）—— 会话历史文件（归档浏览与清理）与健康检查（体检 → 处方 → 出院），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索索引（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出）。不碰会话日志、只做可逆处置。
Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
Create Blender product scenes in DSH with editable recipes, model imports, previews and PNG/MP4 delivery; includes workbench and agent configuration.

DeepSeek Harness companion for ClineBot / ClinePass: dynamic subscription models sync, quota exhaustion warnings, session metrics, dedicated settings page, live usage limits, and /cline slash-command.
Local recording and meeting transcription for DSH on macOS (Apple Silicon only)
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render the session brief — the todo list (the `todos` projection board) plus the artifact list (a live produced-files feed, codeplan artifacts marked) — as a summary tab in the right sidebar, and shadow the official composer-band todo panel so the board…

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move,  (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
One plugin for a calmer DeepSeek Harness: reading view + message rail + smart history loading, for Harness 0.1.0-0.2.1 (all rc).
GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness: native web_search via the Anthropic-compatible Messages API, with GLM response-format translation.
连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成插件：提供 Codegraph 状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index，托管 codegraph MCP 服务器项目目录并向 agent 注入能力提示。
DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置插件：托管 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 的 MCP 区块，支持 stdio / streamable-http、连接测试与启用停用，保存后经 HMR 热加载为 mcp__<server>__<tool> 工具。
通用 DSH 插件库（pnpm monorepo）：模板插件、插件开发工具包、一键聚合安装包。根包同时是全家桶 bundle（dsh.bundle.patch），DSH 与插件市场可直接识别安装。
DSH Web GUI 的 Prompt 管理插件：可视化编辑 systemPrompt，带版本管理与 A/B 分流，可导出 / 导入 / 复制分享，配置存于 ~/.dsh/prompts.yml 的托管区块。
DSH Web GUI 的 RSS / 新闻聚合插件：订阅多个 RSS/Atom 源，每天自动汇总一篇「今日值得读」并注入 systemPrompt 供模型直接引用。
DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏「全局搜索」（⌘/Ctrl + K）命令面板式一处检索历史会话、Prompt、MCP 工具与设置面板。
Check bookmark URLs or Canvas packages, compare sources with host-led research, and retain verifiable reports.
A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness — an opencode-inspired chat client that boots as a dsh profile app plugin. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 的终端界面（TUI），受 opencode 启发，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动。
MACKORN 美矿液压圆锥破（NH/NS）与破碎筛分生产线选型：21 个工具覆盖客户需求表录入、机型/腔型/CSS 选型、整线配置、粒度曲线仿真（Whiten 1972）、实测数据标定、能耗成本估算、衬板磨损设计、经销商评估与 14 章方案书生成。DeepSeek Harness 插件 + MCP 服务器（stdio 与远程 HTTP 双通道），零依赖。
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core
DSH 插件组合包（bundle）：一个包承载多个可独立开关的组件（行），每行对应一个组件包；机器相关配置留在各 profile 覆盖层。
Heartbeat plugin for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled autonomous reflection loop with user profile, material pool, pace gate, and gated proactive expression.
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
DingTalk Stream text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
WeCom AI Bot text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
Official Weixin iLink text, image, and file bridge for DeepSeek Harness
AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口）、左栏「工作台」面板；插件装前宿主兼容预检；官方桌面端「关于」页自升级修复：分离进程 pnpm 通道绕开宿主 already-installed 死路（Windows 适配），附「让 AI 代升级」一句话引导
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
在 DSH 里搜索并播放哔哩哔哩音频：侧边栏「音乐」面板 + 顶部常驻迷你播放条（电台续播 / 可拖拽吸附成悬浮球 / 歌单 / 点赞踩收藏 / 全局热键 / 播放进度记忆）
HTTP/API debugging toolset for DeepSeek Harness: http_request, curl_parse, request_history
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
DSH agent preset「qqbot」：一行 loader 声明，装完即出现在新会话的预设选择器里。
DeepSeek Harness desktop skins and durable per-session token usage summaries
DSH US stock market data plugin, powered by yahoo-finance2
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
Know when your DeepSeek Harness tasks need you. Local alerts, quiet notifications, and a task inbox.

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
